summary: iter179 P0 access-control fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 regression tests in test_iter179_admin_access_control_gate.py pass — anon and every per-portal token (HR/Shop/Safety/Dispatch) are blocked from every sampled /api/admin/* endpoint; admin token still unlocks; K4b mutations reject non-admin tokens; cross-portal /me isolation enforced; multi-logout invalidates the directory session server-side. Frontend: the exact P0 reproduction was executed against the preview URL — super admin signs in → /admin → sign out → HR-only login → HR Hub renders NO PortalSwitcher and NO Admin Console button; direct nav to /admin lands on the 403 'Access Restricted' page. Same flow verified for Shop and PM portals (each lands on portal-specific 403 page with 'Back to <portal> Portal' button). All `masci.(admin|pm|shop|hr|safety|dispatch|directory|safetyforms|dev).(token|user)` localStorage keys are wiped on sign-out AND on landing on any /<portal>/login page (EnforcePortalScope). Sign-out flow correctly clears every per-portal token + directory user + multi-logout call. Verified empirically: only `posthog` cookie key + `masci.device.id` (non-auth) survive sign-out.

EnforcePortalScope wipe-on-login-entry is working: navigating to /shop/login, /hr/login, /pm/login from a populated state correctly leaves NO masci.*.token / masci.*.user keys behind before the user even submits.
PortalSwitcher correctly refuses to render when the directory-user identity doesn't match — confirmed: HR/Shop/PM hubs all show NO portal-switcher-trigger / portal-switcher-admin.
/admin probe under each non-admin portal correctly renders the dedicated 403 page (PortalAccessDenied-style) with the right 'Back to <portal> Portal' destination — good UX continuity.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (from problem statement): stale `masci.directory.user` left in localStorage from a previous super-admin multi-login was never cleared by per-portal sign-out or per-portal login. PortalSwitcher read it and rendered an Admin Console link inside HR/Shop/PM. The backend admin gate was ALREADY rejecting non-admin tokens — the leak was purely a frontend UX failure exposing an attack-surface button. iter179 fix: centralized clearAllSessions() wipes every token+user artifact + best-effort /api/auth/multi-logout; EnforcePortalScope triggers clearAllSessions() on every login-page entry; PortalSwitcher refuses to render unless (a) directory user's portals contain the current portal and (b) the per-portal user object's email matches the directory user email. Verified working against the live preview.
